title: The Curious Case of Curiosity across Human Cultures and LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing human-authored and LLM-generated questions and topic preferences across 18 countries using the CUEST framework, which measures linguistic alignment, topic preference correlation, and grounding in social science theories (e.g., Hofstede's cultural dimensions, Schwartz's values). The paper also evaluates models' cultural adaptability and reliance on Western-centric norms using downstream benchmarks like NormAd, CulturalBench, and Cultural Commonsense.
